ai_summary: Antelopus Selan Energy Limited has been provisionally awarded two significant onshore oil and gas contract areas in the Krishna Godavari and Cambay basins, expected to materially expand its portfolio and support future growth. A key takeaway is that the award, while approved by the Government of India, remains contingent on the execution of a Revenue Sharing Contract, signifying the finalization process is ongoing. This conditionality represents the primary short-term "red flag" or point of uncertainty.
